description: 考研英语一图画作文专用高分词汇与描摹句式表达库

categories.name_cn: 描摹图画核心动词与短语
categories.description: 用于替换普通的 show / see，精准描摹图画场景

expressions.example: The cartoon vividly delineates a touching moment between an elderly mother and her son.

expressions.advanced: feast one's eyes on / gaze at intently
expressions.example: The young student is gazing intently at a poster on the bulletin board.
Four friends cluster around a lavish dinner table in complete silence.

expressions.advanced: be glued to a smartphone screen / bury one's head in a glowing handset
expressions.example: Instead of talking, each diner is glued to a smartphone screen.

expressions.advanced: halt one's steps / grind to a halt
expressions.example: Exhausted from the climb, the mountaineer halts his steps halfway up the slope.
His companion urges him onward with a bottle of water.

categories.name_cn: 文字说明与象征引申句型
categories.description: 精准表述图画中的中文文字与深层象征含义

expressions.advanced: the caption beneath the drawing reads / explicitly denotes
expressions.example: The caption beneath the drawing explicitly denotes: 'Cultural Hotpot: Delicious and Nutritious'.

expressions.advanced: the metaphorical implication of the drawing is that...
expressions.example: The metaphorical implication of the drawing is that perseverance is indispensable for any monumental achievement.

expressions.advanced: the cartoon sounds a resonant alarm against a prevalent social malady
expressions.example: The cartoon sounds a resonant alarm against the chronic interpersonal alienation caused by gadget over-reliance.

expressions.advanced: a stark contrast / a striking irony
expressions.example: There exists a striking irony between their physical proximity and emotional distance.

categories.name_cn: 人物姿态神情与心理描写
categories.description: 使图画描述鲜活生动的高分修饰词

expressions.example: Slumping on the rugged ground, he appears utterly drained.
The resilient climber is beaming with confidence, gazing upward toward the summit.
Staring at the spilled milk on the floor, the pessimist looked utterly crestfallen.

expressions.advanced: absorbed in / immersed in / deeply captivated by
expressions.example: The reader is immersed in a profound book, undisturbed by external noises.

categories.name_cn: 首段引申至第二段论证的高级过渡句
categories.description: 消除生硬痕迹，让篇章浑然一体
expressions: - Far from being a mere caricature, the picture serves as a profound epitome of our contemporary lifestyle.
- What the illustrator aims to convey transcends the literal imagery, shedding light on a critical mindset.
- Simple as the drawing might appear at first glance, its symbolic message provokes deep introspection among viewers.
- This thought-provoking scenario naturally prompts us to ponder the underlying factors behind such a dilemma.
